messages:
Sam B: quick Q — FEATURE_X rollout scenario: org=false, project=true, route unset, model=canary(enable for 10%). If model-level canary exists, do requests hitting a route with no explicit flag inherit the model canary? Also does org=false block the model canary by default?
Neha K: short answer: org-level force_off wins unless the flag explicitly supports org-overrides. precedence we enforce is: route > model > project > org for normal overrides. BUT force_on/force_off at org is absolute unless we opt in.
Carlos M: to add: canary audiences are evaluated where the config is defined. If model defines audience beta_10pct and route has no entry, the model audience applies for requests routed to that model. route can always override if it has an explicit config.
Anya R: here's an example snippet to reason about it:
```json
{"org": {"FEATURE_X": "force_off"}, "project": {"FEATURE_X": "on"}, "model": {"FEATURE_X": {"state": "canary", "audience": "beta_10pct"}}}
```
Neha K: in that exact example final result = disabled for everyone because org.force_off blocks lower scopes. model canary won't run unless we set "allow_org_override": true on the model flag (which is off by default).
Sam B: got it. for the release PR: I want to enable project=true so e2e routes can exercise the feature in CI. will that work while org=false?
Carlos M: no — project=true is ignored if org.force_off. options: (a) request a temporary org flip, (b) use env/test override (dev_override=true) for CI, or (c) create a route-level explicit enable for the test routes (but that still will be blocked by org.force_off).
Anya R: guardrail note: we don't let individual models opt into "allow_org_override" without product signoff + audit log + TTL. otherwise teams could bypass org-level safety. :warning:
Sam B: ok makes sense. i'll mark the PR and coordinate with product if needed.
Neha K: follow-up: we should surface the resolution path in logs when flags are evaluated. e.g. log: "resolved: org(force_off) -> final=false, evaluated_scopes=[org,project,model,route]" so devs don't guess.
release-bot: Deploy queued: rollout/feature_x -> canary 10% on model text-qa (mdl-22). ETA 00:05.
Anya R: action items: 1) @Sam B - add 'needs-org-override' label on PR if you need a temporary flip. 2) @Neha K - please file a small RFC for a safe 'allow-org-override' pattern (audit + TTL + owner). 3) I'll add a short README in flags repo explaining precedence + examples. :memo:
Sam B: thanks all — i'll do the PR label and follow up on the RFC thread.
Neha K: also, quick debug trick: you can force-evaluate a user id against a model's canary locally using `flags-cli resolve --user 123 --model text-qa` to see which scope wins.
Carlos M: +1 for logs + CLI helper. saves a lot of pinging.
Sam B: perfect, closing this check-in. :tada:
